_note: Indicative statutory maxima as of November 2026. Not predictions. Items marked verify need confirmation in a primary source.

EU.max: EUR 20M or 4% of worldwide annual turnover (whichever is higher)
at least 4% of annual turnover in the member states concerned, or EUR 2M where turnover is unknown
EUR 15M or 3% of worldwide annual turnover

AT.max: administrative fines up to EUR 3,000 (ECG) and EUR 20,000 (MedienG) (verify)

FR.max: EUR 375,000 for legal entities, EUR 75,000 + 1 year for individuals
scales with worldwide turnover (Google EUR 325M, Shein EUR 150M in 2025) (verify cap)
administrative fines up to EUR 75,000 per breach for legal entities

IT.max: up to EUR 10M or 4% of turnover

NL.max: up to EUR 900,000 per violation or 10% of turnover

IE.max: up to EUR 250,000 per offence for companies (criminal)

CH.max: up to CHF 250,000 on responsible individuals

CA.max: administrative penalties up to C$10M or 2%; penal fines up to C$25M or 4%
the greater of CAD 10M (CAD 15M for repeat orders), 3× the benefit, or 3% of worldwide gross revenue

BR.max: 2% of Brazilian revenue, capped at R$50M per infraction

KR.max: up to 3% of total revenue (10% in aggravated cases, 2026 amendment)

CN.max: up to CNY 50M or 5% of previous-year revenue

IN.max: up to INR 250 crore per breach

AU.max: the greater of A$50M, 3× the benefit, or 30% of adjusted turnover
the greater of A$50M, 3× the benefit, or 30% of adjusted turnover

SG.max: up to 10% of Singapore turnover or S$1M

VN.max: up to 5% of revenue for cross-border transfer breaches

SA.max: up to SAR 5M (doubled for repeat offences) + criminal liability

NG.max: the higher of 2% of annual gross revenue or ₦10M for data controllers and processors of major importance (₦2M for others)

ZA.max: up to R10M and/or 10 years' imprisonment

KE.max: KES 5M or 1% of turnover, whichever is lower
